constraints: fontes[].verificacao (optional): confirmado | parcial | nao_verificado (source read for BK-04: supports / supports in part / not read); fontes[].url (optional, https): deep link to the exact payload/page that anchors the claim, shown instead of referencias[r].url
recon.sinal_alvo[] must reference sinais with tipo=passivo
all ids unique within each file
clusters.defesa_para_cluster must cover every defesa id exactly once (no gaps, no duplicates)
triagem.perguntas[].opcoes must have exactly 2 items (A and B), each with a rotulo and a destino: either a valid pergunta id (string) or an object with 'familia' and 'clusters'
tecnicas.bypass[] and evasoes.bypass[] must not be empty; defesa unique within the item
bypass[].base != nao_auditado requires fonte (present in the item's fontes) and nota
tecnicas.grupo must be in taxonomia.grupo_ordem; grupo_descricoes keys must equal grupo_ordem
translations/{en,es}/{tecnicas,evasoes,produtos}.json are overlays: only id, nome, descricao, variantes[].descricao, rotulos[], bypass[].{defesa,nota}; same ids as data/
taxonomia: exactly one ramo with gerado='tecnicas' (children generated at build from tecnicas)
translations/{en,es}/{defesas,sinais,recon,wiki,triagem,clusters}.json are overlays: same ids and list lengths as PT, only translatable text keys, pt_hash equal to the hash of the PT item
recon.prompts[].componente is required when grupo=arquitetura and forbidden otherwise (enum recon.componente)
coverage: every sinal with tipo=passivo has at least one recon probe with matching sinal_alvo
every defesa has at least one fraqueza
